project_identity.name: Sapiens
inspirations: Notion (Minimalist bento, clean monochrome, high whitespace)
Stripe (Perfect optical alignment, tracing beams, precise metrics)
project_identity.theme: Light theme preferred (matches Apple/Notion clean aesthetic). Crisp white backgrounds with deep contrast typography.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Old Money Tech

headings.usage: Hero title, large numbers in dashboard, widget titles.

body.usage: Paragraphs, data labels, tooltips, secondary text.

colors.archetype: Swiss High-Contrast with Vibrant Data Accents
rules: No full-screen gradients. Use pure white or #FAFAFA for breathing room.
Data viz colors must be distinct. Green for mastered skills, Coral/Red for deficient skills.
Hover states for buttons must be a lighter hue (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 for primary black buttons).

surfaces: The 'Crystal' Variant: Use bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl for the top navigation bar and floating action buttons.
The 'Tactile' Variant: Use white cards with a 1px solid border-zinc-200 and a very soft shadow (shadow-sm) for dashboard widgets (Notion style).
The 'Tracing Beam': Use a subtle animated gradient border on the 'Premium R$4.99/mês' upsell card to make it feel magical (Stripe style).
visual_enhancers.shapes: Slightly rounded corners. max border-radius of 12px (rounded-xl) for cards, rounded-full for pill buttons.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for UI elements. Clean, stroke-based icons. 1.5px stroke width.

components.hero: Minimalist center-aligned or bento. Massive 'Sapiens' title, clean subtitle. Pill-shaped primary CTA. Background should be mostly white with an abstract geometric wave.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary is solid black (bg-zinc-950 text-white). Secondary is outline (border-zinc-200 text-zinc-900). Use scale transform on click (active:scale-95).
components.dashboard_cards: No heavy shadows. Use border-zinc-200, bg-white, p-6 or p-8. High density layout. Hide complex filters behind a 'More' dropdown.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Line charts for evolution with smooth curves (type='monotone'). Radar charts for 'Radar de Habilidades'. Bar charts for 'Distribuição de Erros'. Strip away grid lines to keep it minimal.
components.learning_map: Use 'react-force-graph-2d' or 'visx' to render the knowledge graph. Nodes should be colored based on mastery level. Smooth zoom/pan.
components.premium_upsell: Minimalist block, subtle shimmer effect, deep black or indigo background to stand out from the rest of the white UI.

grids_layouts.spacing_system: Use generous padding. Dashboard containers should have gap-6 or gap-8. Page horizontal padding should be px-6 md:px-12.
grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Main charts take col-span-2 or col-span-3. Side feeds take col-span-1.
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and data. Center-align the main landing page hero.
grids_layouts.mobile: Always ensure 100% width on mobile (grid-cols-1). Hide complex tables inside scrollable X containers.

motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-transform duration-200 ease-out.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow. Use framer-motion for page entrances (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0).
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders (shimmering rects) instead of spinning wheels for widgets to maintain the premium Stripe-like feel.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Gray text must be at least text-zinc-500 on white backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.description: Abstract clean white geometry with wavy lines. Place with very low opacity or as a masked background in the landing hero.
Minimalist studying desk. Use for the empty state of the dashboard or login screen.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use 'react-force-graph-2d' for the 'Mapa de Aprendizagem' (Knowledge Graph) to show root-causes. It provides a lightweight, highly interactive network graph that fits the analytical nature of the app without the heavy overhead of 3D.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing/landing page components to ensure complete layout freedom.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactivity (Dropdowns, Tabs, Dialogs) but strip out default Vercel aesthetics to match the crisp Apple/Notion look (1px subtle borders, white backgrounds).
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all actionable elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, map nodes) and data blocks.
Implement a smooth scroll using standard CSS or Framer Motion.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Always use bg-white/70 + backdrop-blur-xl or solid colors.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-opacity).
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) to avoid a cramped, cheap look.
No AI emojis in the UI (🤖🧠💭). Use clean icons from lucide-react.
Use sonner for toasts, customized to match the monochrome + colored accent theme.
